title: Safety Incident Request Form
subtitle: Use this request to route the need, test readiness, document review, authorize a bounded action, and verify implementation for a safety incident workflow.
description: An original operational safety incident request form that controls a workplace safety event and corrective-action record from identity and routing through evidence, qualified decision, exception management, implementation, handoff, and final verification.
use_case: Use when the reporting worker, supervisor, or incident coordinator needs a traceable request so the qualified safety, occupational health, operations, or regulatory reviewer can stabilize, investigate, classify, notify, correct, reopen work, or escalate the safety event under the emergency procedure, hazard-control plan, incident-investigation process, reporting rules, and anti-retaliation policy without relying on an informal email, spreadsheet, or unreviewed narrative.

sections.title: Safety Incident request identity and routing
sections.guidance: Open one traceable request and identify the responsible reviewers before work begins.

blocks.label: Requested outcome, initiating event, business need, affected people or work, and explicit exclusions

sections.title: Requested safety incident scope and operating need
sections.guidance: Describe the exact requested action and the evidence needed to evaluate it.

blocks.label: Safety Incident request type
items: Immediate hazard control or emergency response request
Injury, illness, exposure, or symptom report needing qualified routing
Near miss or high-potential event investigation
Property, equipment, vehicle, or environmental safety event
Unsafe condition or unsafe-system observation
Work-stop, isolation, restricted-area, or restart review
Corrective-action, engineering-control, or procedure-change request
External reporting determination by a qualified safety reviewer

blocks.label: Operational reason, intended result, assumptions, dependencies, alternatives, and timing impact

sections.title: Safety Incident readiness, policy, and impact review
sections.guidance: Confirm the request can be reviewed without bypassing privacy, safety, security, or authority controls.

blocks.label: Safety Incident readiness checkpoints
items: Emergency services, first aid, medical evaluation, or evacuation need is addressed
Immediate hazard is isolated and affected area controlled
People are accounted for and qualified support is notified
Event time, location, task, equipment, material, and operating state are captured
Photographs, video, physical items, alarms, logs, and system data preserve provenance
Reporter and witness accounts are collected separately and without coaching
Exposure, injury, illness, or symptom information is routed confidentially
Potential recurrence and similarly exposed work are identified
Investigation considers systemic and root causes rather than worker blame
Corrective actions include owner, due point, interim control, and effectiveness test
Qualified reviewer makes recordability and external-notification decisions
Work restart and closeout require evidence that controls are effective

blocks.label: Request and authority boundary
blocks.guidance: This request does not itself authorize action. The qualified safety, occupational health, operations, or regulatory reviewer must apply the emergency procedure, hazard-control plan, incident-investigation process, reporting rules, and anti-retaliation policy, resolve exceptions, and record any conditions before implementation.

sections.title: Safety Incident review, alternatives, and decision
sections.guidance: Compare the request to the governing evidence and document why the selected route is appropriate.

blocks.label: Requirement, evidence, finding, and decision matrix
Evidence considered, alternatives rejected, approved limits, exception treatment, and communication plan

sections.title: Approved safety incident implementation and exception handoff
sections.guidance: Translate the decision into owned work without losing a condition or system update.

blocks.label: Approved action, condition, system update, and completion evidence
Implementation and communication controls
items: Immediate hazard and affected scope are controlled
Emergency, occupational-health, and external-reporting routes were reviewed
Investigation team has appropriate independence and worker participation
Evidence and factual accounts are sufficiently preserved
Cause analysis addresses system conditions and rejected alternatives
Interim and permanent controls have owners and due points
Restart criteria and authority are explicit
Reporter protection, communication, and effectiveness follow-up are documented

blocks.label: Implementation variance, failed dependency, changed fact, immediate action, and reapproval need

sections.title: Safety Incident request completion and closeout
sections.guidance: Close only when the implemented result, remaining limits, and receiving ownership are verifiable.

blocks.label: Open safety incident action and limitation register
Closeout and recipient handoff confirmations
items: Final decision and effective boundary are recorded
Evidence supporting the outcome is linked and readable
Every unresolved action has an owner and due point
Sensitive information is routed only to the designated restricted record
Affected people and receiving systems received the necessary status
Conditions, limitations, and escalation triggers remain visible
Required payroll, schedule, access, asset, or workflow update is confirmed
Follow-up review or reopen condition has an accountable owner

blocks.label: Final evidence, decision rationale, remaining limitation, communication, and acceptance
